title: Lumbar segment ROM at 7.5 Nm, intact (Wilke 2001 group, re-plotted in Schmidt 2007)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: one-sided rotation at 7.5 Nm; median, SD (half-length of dot-ended bar), min-max

source.authors: Schmidt H, Heuer F, Drumm J, Klezl Z, Claes L, Wilke HJ
source.sample: secondary re-plot: two groups of 6 lumbar specimens from Wilke et al. 2006 (bilateral hemifacetectomy; median age 57, 28-68) and Wilke et al. 2001 (nucleotomy; median age 50, 43-57); level not stated in Schmidt 2007 (FE model is L4-L5; Wilke 2025 Table 4 lists Wilke 2001 as L4-L5 and Wilke 2006 as L3-S1)

protocol.summary: Ulm protocol: pure moments 7.5 Nm flexion/extension, no preload, unconstrained; in vitro ROM median with SD and min/max as re-plotted in Schmidt 2007 Fig 6.
how_to_simulate: Fix caudal vertebra; apply pure moment 7.5 Nm in flexion and extension without preload
Report segmental rotation at 7.5 Nm, intact and after the defect
Hemifacetectomy = removal of FL and both inferior articular processes of the upper vertebra with the corresponding capsules; nucleotomy = nucleus removed via right lateral approach
protocol.notes: Secondary data (re-plotted). Error bars: thick dot-ended line = median ± SD (dots symmetric about the median), thin capped line = min-max. The third group in Fig 6 (w/o SSL&ISL, dark grey) is Heuer 2007a's group and matched Table 1 medians within 0.02 deg (6.18/4.09 intact, 6.63/4.51 w/oSSL&ISL) - not re-extracted; but its min/max in Fig 6 (flexion ~4.1-9.6) disagree with Heuer 2007a Fig 4 (4.15-8.14) and Schmidt says each group had 6 specimens vs 8 in Heuer 2007a: treat Schmidt Fig 6 spreads with caution.

extraction.from: Fig 6 (white bars = Wilke 2006 group, light grey = Wilke 2001 group)
extraction.uncertainty: ±0.1 deg for medians (method reproduced Heuer 2007a values within 0.02 deg), ±0.15 deg for SD and min/max; extension min of the Wilke 2001 group partly hidden by its SD marker
extraction.check_notes: Gridlines calibrated (0-14 deg, 33.3 px/deg at 300 dpi); bar ends cross-checked on the Heuer group against Heuer 2007a Table 1 (|diff| <= 0.02 deg); SD dots symmetric about median (6.73 vs 6.72). | verified 2026-11-12 sign check: OK (Fig 6 p6 image: extension axis plotted as positive magnitudes 0-14 deg; all values positive and consistent)

pass_rule.rule: |model-median| <= 1 SD (PASS); min <= model <= max (SUFFICIENT) - the Schmidt 2007 grading

shared_sample_with: wilke2025: Wilke 2001 (n=6, L4-L5) listed in Wilke 2025 Table 4
